verdict.rationale: Marqeta docs confirm a dedicated disputes API for the Mastercard network (create dispute cases with type-specific details) and general webhook infrastructure for API events, plus an MCP-based 'dispute resolution' conversational feature with automatic data collection. However, there's no evidence of network reason code handling, explicit evidence-submission endpoints, provisional credit handling, or dispute-specific status webhooks through resolution. Missing for 10: reason code taxonomy support, evidence upload/attachment endpoints, provisional credit issuance mechanics, and dispute-status webhook event documentation.
